facts.notes: Base statutory tuition for Indian UG new entrants in 2026–27, before exemptions. Annualized using two semesters at the listed rate; future semester fees may change. SC/ST/PwD tuition exemption applies. Hostel, other charges and deposits are excluded. Check other applicable remissions with IIT Bombay.

source.title: IIT Bombay UG new entrants fee circular, Autumn 2026–27, page 2

facts.notes: The circular states a four-year, eight-semester B.Tech programme. This is the standard programme duration.
